newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,599 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,599 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 1,599 contracts compared with 2,045 overnight Sunday.
There were 68 wheat, 295 corn, 1,027 soybean, 140 soymeal, 44 soyoil, 18 oat, two corn calls and five corn puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 3/4 to two cents higher, corn was steady to one cent lower and soybeans were 2-1/4 to 9-1/2 cents lower.
